mapper.select: SELECT ctwcp.id, ctwcp.work_card_id AS workCardId, wc.code AS workCardCode, wc.name AS workCardName, wc.repair_type_id AS repairTypeId, rt.name AS repairTypeName, wc.part_number_id AS partNumberId, pn.code AS partNumberCode, pn.name AS partNumber, ctwcp.product_id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, p.spec AS productSpec, p.unit AS productUnit, ctwcp.quantity, pmt.name AS machineTypeName, rpmt.name AS productMachineTypeName FROM shkb_contract_task_work_card_product AS ctwcp LEFT JOIN shkb_work_card AS wc ON ctwcp.work_card_id = wc.id LEFT JOIN base_data_repair_type AS rt ON wc.repair_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN base_data_product AS p ON ctwcp.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN base_data_product AS pn ON wc.part_number_id = pn.id LEFT JOIN base_data_machine_type AS pmt ON pn.machine_type_id = pmt.id LEFT JOIN base_data_machine_type AS rpmt ON p.machine_type_id = rpmt.id WHERE ctwcp.task_id = #{taskId}
